content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets such as ebooks, templates, and fonts without traditional payment platforms is not just an option; it's a necessity for many creators today. The reliance on platforms like Stripe and PayPal creates significant hurdles, especially in countries where these services are either unavailable or heavily restricted. By utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can bypass these limitations. This infrastructure ensures that they retain full ownership of their assets, set their prices without exorbitant fees, and leverage crypto payments for seamless transactions. The broader implication is financial independence in a digital economy increasingly reliant on decentralized solutions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling digital products with crypto payments hinges on a carefully constructed stack that includes free hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. By utilizing tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and combining them with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, creators can establish a fully operational online store. The integration of NOWPayments for crypto transactions simplifies payment processing, allowing creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This architecture not only enhances the user experience for buyers but also streamlines the operations for sellers, ensuring that every transaction is secure and efficient.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are absent or heavily restricted. Whether you are an ebook author in Nigeria, a course creator in Kenya, or a designer in Venezuela, this stack allows you to sell your digital assets without the barriers imposed by traditional platforms. It empowers individuals to bypass financial isolation and thrive in a global digital marketplace. By leveraging this infrastructure, creators can focus on their craft while ensuring that they receive fair compensation for their work.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this system relies on several key components that work in unison. First, there is the hosting solution, which could be GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a reliable platform for your store. Next, the backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that order processing and delivery are automated. For storage, creators can utilize Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments facilitates the processing of crypto transactions, providing a seamless checkout experience for customers. Each piece of this infrastructure is designed to support the needs of digital creators looking for autonomy and efficiency.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin selling your design assets with this infrastructure, first, choose your hosting solution—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages will get you started. Next, set up your backend logic using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After that, create an order management system through Supabase or Google Sheets. Ensure your files are stored and delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to enable crypto payment processing. For a comprehensive guide and all necessary templates, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates free hosting, backend logic, and crypto payment processing. This approach ensures you retain full control over your assets while minimizing transaction fees. With NOWPayments, you can process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with just a 0.5% fee, significantly less than traditional platforms.
Empower your sales with crypto payments, no platform restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for alternatives to Gumroad or Payhip for selling templates and fonts, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates required to establish a robust sovereign digital commerce stack. Start building your store today at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies for your digital products. This flexibility allows customers to pay using their preferred crypto, enhancing the buying experience.

NOWPayments offers several benefits, including low transaction fees of just 0.5%, no KYC requirements, and the ability to process payments in real-time. This makes it an ideal choice for digital creators looking to optimize their revenue.
